description.value: Delany's Coffee is a family-owned Vancouver coffee institution founded in 1993, growing from a 200-square-foot Denman Street kiosk to a multi-location Lower Mainland chain. The Denman Street location sits on one of Vancouver's primary cycling corridors leading to the Stanley Park Seawall, making it a natural stop for riders. The brand runs an Athlete Ambassadors program, suggesting an active-community orientation.
